items.title: 3 Reasons to Avoid BEN and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Franklin Resources’s 22.9% return over the past six months has outpaced the S&P 500 by 9.8%, and its stock price has climbed to $34.31 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: TROW's July AUM Slips on Outflows: Can Diversification Support Growth?
items.summary: Can T. Rowe Price's diversified asset base and expanding alternatives platform offset equity outflows and support AUM growth? Let us discuss.

items.title: Lazard's AUM Rises in July: Will the Growth Momentum Continue?
items.summary: LAZ's AUM rises marginally in July to $286.9B on market appreciation despite net outflows. Let's see if it can sustain AUM growth on strong client demand.

items.title: Franklin's AUM Expansion: Can Diversification Support Growth Momentum?
items.summary: Can BEN sustain AUM growth as diversification, strong inflows and digital-asset expansion drive its record $1.79 trillion AUM as of June 30, 2026? Let us discuss.

items.title: Lessons for Investors From a Former Star Fund Manager’s Guilty Plea
items.summary: Former fund manager Ken Leech left plenty of clues in plain sight about his cherry-picking activity, a report finds.

items.title: 2 Top-Ranked High-Flying Non-AI Bigwigs to Buy at Lucrative Valuation

items.title: Invesco Hits a New 52-Week High: Is There Further Upside Potential?
